speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice of Early Onset).

The lab results show a total bilirubin of 16.1 mg/dL with a normal direct bilirubin of 0.7 mg/dL, indicating unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, and liver enzymes are within normal limits. Given the 2-week age and exclusive breastfeeding history without signs of liver disease, this is consistent with breastfeeding jaundice rather than biliary atresia or other pathologic causes.
